thread:
maria: Quick decision needed on continuous-batching queue governance. can we settle on one implementable shape?
cheng: propose `hybrid-escrow` (local escrow ledger + periodic reconcile). cheap ops: reserve/commit/rollback locally; heartbeat every 200-250ms.
aj: sounds pragmatic. how to handle cross-lane moves?
cheng: runtime absorbs transient headroom delta, emits an `allocation_change` event for billing/telemetry. add guard: reject move if delta > 20% tenant_quota OR > 1GiB.
sam: eviction default?
maria: prefer `evict(oldest_soft)` then `evict(largest)`. instrument `evictions_by_reason`, `failed_moves`, `reconcile_lag_ms`.
alex: event schema minimal example: `{"event":"allocation_change","tenant":"t-9","from":"coalesce","to":"iso","delta":128}`. heartbeats signed with HMAC.
aj: keep wire tiny. control plane signals: `tighten(cap)` / `relax(cap)` / `evict(reason)`.
cheng: will update RFC with pseudocode for `reserve()/commit()`, heartbeat sketch, and the tiny wire format.
maria: freeze shape by EOD Friday. assign PRs and telemetry dashboards.
ci-bot: CI job queued for branch `hybrid/escrow-ledger` (#4567).
maria: thanks, keep thread updated with PR link. :thumbsup:
